## How it works

- [statement] setOnInsert applies only when an upsert inserts a document; the documented invocation passes new UpdateOptions().upsert(true). (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/builders/updates.md · keywords: Java sync driver CRUD, Filters/Updates builders and POJO codecs

## How-to and procedures

- [statement] Configure a POJO collection by combining the default codec registry with a PojoCodecProvider registry, applying it to the database or collection, and passing the POJO class to getCollection(). (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/data-formats/document-data-format-pojo.md · keywords: Java sync driver CRUD, Filters/Updates builders and POJO codecs · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/data-formats/pojo-customization.md

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] JAVA-6138 reports that generic hierarchy serialization that worked in 5.5.x failed in 5.6.x with a CodecConfigurationException for java.lang.Object while encoding a Map<String, Object> property. Treat this as a version-specific reported regression rather than a universal POJO limitation. (low confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/JAVA-6138 · keywords: Java sync driver CRUD, Filters/Updates builders and POJO codecs

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Filters provides static factories that produce BSON query filters usable by find, update and delete methods; the POJO CRUD example also uses Filters.lte and Filters.eq. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/builders/filters.md · keywords: Java sync driver CRUD, Filters/Updates builders and POJO codecs · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/data-formats/document-data-format-pojo.md
- [statement] Filters supplies comparison helpers including eq, gt, gte, lt, lte, in and nin, plus logical and/or composition. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/builders/filters.md · keywords: Java sync driver CRUD, Filters/Updates builders and POJO codecs
- [statement] Automatic POJO mapping follows JavaBean getter/setter conventions and can access public fields directly. Quarkus independently documents the same PojoCodecProvider field/accessor model. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/data-formats/document-data-format-pojo.md · keywords: Java sync driver CRUD, Filters/Updates builders and POJO codecs · also: https://quarkus.io/guides/mongodb-panache
- [statement] BsonProperty customizes the BSON field name, BsonId selects the identifier property, and BsonIgnore controls whether a property is serialized or deserialized. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/data-formats/pojo-customization.md · keywords: Java sync driver CRUD, Filters/Updates builders and POJO codecs · also: https://quarkus.io/guides/mongodb-panache
- [statement] POJO codecs call an empty no-argument constructor by default. With annotation conventions enabled, BsonCreator selects a different constructor or public static creator; constructor parameters require BsonProperty or BsonId annotations. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/data-formats/pojo-customization.md · keywords: Java sync driver CRUD, Filters/Updates builders and POJO codecs
- [statement] Generic POJO properties require concrete bounded type parameters. ClassModelBuilder retains concrete type information to work around erasure; PropertyCodecProvider permits custom handling of generic property types. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/data-formats/pojo-customization.md · keywords: Java sync driver CRUD, Filters/Updates builders and POJO codecs
- [statement] Since driver 4.5 the PojoCodecProvider no longer supplies enum conversion itself; include an enum codec such as the default registry provider. Codec registries use precedence order, so a custom enum codec can be placed before the default registry. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/data-formats/pojo-customization.md · keywords: Java sync driver CRUD, Filters/Updates builders and POJO codecs · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/data-formats/codecs.md
- [statement] The Java sync driver uses filter builders for find, update and delete predicates; the POJO CRUD example uses Filters with updateOne and deleteOne. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/builders/filters.md · keywords: Java sync driver CRUD, Filters/Updates builders and POJO codecs · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/data-formats/document-data-format-pojo.md
- [statement] Compose predicates with and or or; eq tests equality, and an empty filter matches all documents. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/builders/filters.md · keywords: Java sync driver CRUD, Filters/Updates builders and POJO codecs
- [statement] PojoCodecProvider can use automatic(true) for predefined POJO conversion; explicit registration supports individual classes, packages and ClassModel instances. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/data-formats/document-data-format-pojo.md · keywords: Java sync driver CRUD, Filters/Updates builders and POJO codecs · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/data-formats/pojo-customization.md
- [statement] The documented POJO generics support requires concrete bounded type parameters and restricts type parameters on top-level POJOs in class hierarchies; PropertyCodecProvider can supply codecs that use generic property type information. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/data-formats/pojo-customization.md · keywords: Java sync driver CRUD, Filters/Updates builders and POJO codecs
- [statement] For a POJO property declared as an abstract class or interface, the customization guide requires discriminators on that type and its subtypes or implementations. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/java/sync/current/data-formats/pojo-customization.md · keywords: Java sync driver CRUD, Filters/Updates builders and POJO codecs
